task.description:
Produce a test specification for API-10 (Rate limiting) at tests/specs/API-10.md.

Required test cases:
1. Token within limit: 1,000 requests in a window all return non-429
2. Token exceeds limit: request N+1 returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After header
3. Retry-After value: is a positive integer (seconds until window resets); equals 0 if window just reset
4. No state change on 429: the route handler is not invoked (verify via a side effect or mock)
5. Per-token override: a token with a custom limit (e.g. 10/min) is limited at 10, not 1000
6. Default fallback: a token with no configured limit uses the global default (1000)
7. Window reset: after the 1-minute window expires, the counter resets and requests succeed again
8. Rate limit is per-token (not per-IP): two different tokens do not share counters
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/API-10.md is created with all 8 test cases
Each test case has: ID, name, preconditions, steps, expected result
Test cases cover the Retry-After edge case (value 0)

result.summary: Created tests/specs/API-10.md with 9 unit test cases (7 mapped to existing inline tests in rate_limit.zig, 2 flagged as new) and 6 integration test cases for tests/integration/rate_limit_test.zig. Covers all 8 required scenarios. Identified 2 unit test gaps (TC-API-10-08: per-token env var override; TC-API-10-09: explicit limitForToken default assertion) and 6 integration test gaps (HTTP-level verification of 429, Retry-After header, no-handler-invocation, window reset, and per-token isolation).
